### The Vocation of Elder
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/vocation-of-elder
Passage: 1 Timothy 3:1–7
Points:
- The Protestant Reformation recognized the dignity of ordinary work while upholding the biblical calling and distinct responsibilities of ordained officers.
- In the New Testament, the Greek terms for "overseer" and "elder" describe the same pastoral office of church leadership.
- The qualifications in this passage highlight personal character and integrity, including self-control, respectability, and effectively managing one's own household.
- Spiritual oversight centers on prayer, study, and the ministry of teaching God's Word according to Scripture.
- Elders serve as God's gift to shepherd the flock, calling church members to follow their lawful direction and pray for them.
